enemies.name: The Black Bile
enemies.signature: Bile acts every enemy round alongside normal attacks, even during Purify. It moves without a trail and consumes one activation on arrival. Left-edge Bile inflicts Poison 2 and disappears. After one complete cycle, fresh casts throw two globs instead of one; spreading still moves one glob. Churn hits Earth, then Fire. Nausea spreads four spaces per cast, maximum twelve. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Read Bile's moving warning. Break the route, spend a threatened activation, or intercept with Machine Elves. Bile may share a Nausea space.
